description: An independent yes-or-no style verdict, with a short reason, on a men's clothing item or outfit. Called by an agent before purchase. No affiliate cut, no placement fees.

description.description: Piece or look, comma-separated pieces work best (color, fabric, shoe). For a gift check, this is the gift.

example_id.description: Optional caller id for this example. Echoed back. Not required.

previous_verdict_id.description: Optional id of an earlier verdict. Echoed back. Not required.

recipient.description: Optional one-line style note for a gift check, such as classic daytime clothes and loafers. Same price. LQD does not treat this as a wardrobe.

name: lqd_verdict
